mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 AM, here is today's balanced dish: current temperatures are holding at 57 degrees under overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School. We also have a full moon out tonight. Regarding the ISS, it will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

In city news, the Finance Department has released the 2027 proposed budget and 2025 financial statements. Additionally, the Plan Commission is set to meet on November 4th at 6:30 p.m. to review several developments, including the Ardent Glen third addition and new site plans for Milky Way.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, you can catch live music at both Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia on October 27th at Hop Haus Brewing and Wisconsin Brewing Company.

On October 15th, the Verona Police Department arrested a school bus driver for O W I. Officers responded to reports of dangerous driving and confirmed the driver was impaired while transporting students, though thankfully no injuries occurred.
If you are craving something sweet, today's flavor of the day is Snickers Swirl. The store is closed right now, but it will open today at 10:00 AM.
